quests.title: Venom for the Road Wardens
quests.text: The new road from Gor Drazhak runs straight through both front lines, and the road wardens need arrows that bite. Sinkmire Vipers lie in the {name:front_broken_causeway/reedmire} of the Causeway by day {zone_area:front_broken_causeway/reedmire}; bring me two Scorch Venom. The Accord dips its arrows too, so we dip faster.

quests.title: Fangs for the Recruits
quests.text: On the other side of the road, Warpack Hyenas hunt the {name:front_shattered_line/trenches} of the Shattered Line by day {zone_area:front_shattered_line/trenches}. Kill four and bring two Siegepack Fangs. Every new recruit gets one; it is cheaper than a medal.

quests.title: Bounty: The Wreck Shore
quests.text: Last-Watch Mummies wash up on the {name:front_stormscale_summit/wreck_shore} of Stormscale Summit by day {zone_area:front_stormscale_summit/wreck_shore}. Buy a boat from the Shipwright, sail across and lay eight of them down. The war chest pays in coin, again an hour after you collect.
